notes.title: Update to Version 3.0.22
notes.content:
In this Content Patch...

- "Bitter Stalks" duration error finally corrected
- Background conflicts (or lack of appropriate conflicts) resolved
- Multiple Item categories altered for usability
- Minor Item Ability corrections
- Some minor Skill revisions, with at least one new Ability added
- Minor Location Ability revisions
- Missing Adventure Exit names (and in a few really galling instances Exit text) restored
- Minor Ability/Action prereq revisions
- Multiple Lores rewritten for clarity (and editorial sanity)
- An Adventure and an RE from Rhialto added
- 500++ typos corrected

Thank you to all who worked with us to provide data and corrections. 

As always.....
--------------------------------------------------
If you are having problems with the update/download (it gets paused for unexplained reasons), try exiting Steam and restarting your computer. You may need to right click on the game in Steam, to manage/resume the download.

For other common issues, please visit our Troubleshooting topic over at the official forums:

http://academagia.invisionzone.com/index.php?s=7df238425b1cebfc489a442a759b9519&showtopic=516

Cheers,
Black Chicken Studios

notes.title: Update to Version 3.0.11
notes.content:
This update includes:


(1) Options like Exiting the game, and Turning Off/On the music, have been enabled during Story mode.
(2) A rare crash caused by Binding Phemes during Dueling has been fixed, as well as UI oddities related to Dueling.
(3) Fields in the Control window are no longer slightly cut off at the bottom.
(4) Clique break up prevention is now working correctly, allowing one day to resolve any relationship issues.
(5) Cache-related error detection has been improved to auto-delete the cache when it has become corrupted.



As always.....
--------------------------------------------------
If you are having problems with the update/download (it gets paused for unexplained reasons), try exiting Steam and restarting your computer. You may need to right click on the game in Steam, to manage/resume the download.

For other common issues, please visit our Troubleshooting topic over at the official forums:

http://academagia.invisionzone.com/index.php?s=7df238425b1cebfc489a442a759b9519&showtopic=516

Thank you to all who worked with us to provide data and helped to solve these problems. 

Cheers,
Black Chicken Studios

notes.title: Update to Version 3.0.9
notes.content:
This update includes:

(1) Ability to Lock Layout 
(2) Fix for major problems with Steam overlay. Shift/Tabbing issue is related to this.
(3) Fix for 1-member clique issue and no reporting when cliques break up 
(4) Improvement to differentiate new story text from old story text after choice selection
(5) Fix for rare crash involving saves and not being able to load them due to corrupt config file. If you think you are still having this problem, be sure to delete your old config.xml file in the main Academagia install folder.


As always.....
--------------------------------------------------
If you are having problems with the update/download (it gets paused for unexplained reasons), try exiting Steam and restarting your computer. You may need to right click on the game in Steam, to manage/resume the download.

For other common issues, please visit our Troubleshooting topic over at the official forums:

http://academagia.invisionzone.com/index.php?s=7df238425b1cebfc489a442a759b9519&showtopic=516

Thank you to all who worked with us to provide data and helped to solve these problems. 

Cheers,
Black Chicken Studios

notes.title: Update to Version 3.0.8
notes.content:
This update includes:

(1) Fix for bug related to Clique Abilities not appearing under your abilities (your old saves should be fine)
(2) Fix for duplicate windows for entering Familiar Name
(3) You can now Save a Game by pressing "Enter" instead of the down arrow button next to it
(4) Spacing added between radio buttons and Story choices

Thank you to all who worked with us to provide data and helped to solve these problems. The first one is a major bug, so we recommend that you enable updates.

If you are having problems with the update/download (it gets paused for unexplained reasons), try exiting Steam and restarting your computer. You may need to right click on the game in Steam, to manage/resume the download.

For other common issues, please visit our Troubleshooting topic over at the official forums:

http://academagia.invisionzone.com/index.php?s=7df238425b1cebfc489a442a759b9519&showtopic=516

Cheers,
Black Chicken Studios
